sections.overview: D/A converter unit exclusively for 75  coaxial digital input developed with CD Transport ROK-DP1.The signal board is fixed directly inside the rear panel to guide the input signal to the circuit at the shortest distance and to send it out at the shortest distance.In addition, in order to avoid degradation of sound quality due to wiring and switch contact, etc., input is one coaxial system and output is one analog system only.The power supply of the toroidal transformer is mounted on the part of the under chassis, and the position where the interference with the signal system is minimized is selected and fixed. sections.title: ROTEL RE-2000
sections.overview: A stereo octave equalizer that enables fine sound field improvement and range correction.The equalizer circuit uses a semiconductor resonant circuit (ILAR) that consists of transistors, capacitors, and resistors. This reduces the external influence compared with a circuit using a coil, and prevents S/N deterioration due to electromagnetic induction hum, etc.The RE-2000uses an FET in the first stage to eliminate the input coupling capacitor and uses a metallized film capacitor for the output coupling capacitor to improve sound quality.The power supply circuit is composed of a current limiter circuit and an AMP-type constant voltage circuit to improve the ripple suppression ratio and to lower the source impedance, thereby reducing distortion and crosstalk.It is divided into 10bands independently on the left and right, and can be adjusted within   12dB by sliding volume.Two tape decks can be connected, and 1? 2/2? 1can be dubbed mutually by switching.The EQ can be used in either playback, recording or dubbing mode. The dubbing switch and monitor switch are independent, so both signals can be monitored alternately by operating the switch during dubbing.Equipped with an equalizer selector switch.In the Normal position, the equalizer is applied only for playback. In the Bypass position, the input / output terminals are connected directly and the equalizer circuit jumps. In the EQ REC position, the equalizer is applied for both dubbing and Source ? recording.* Direct connection to a power amplifier without volume is not recommended.

sections.title: ROTEL RT-2000
sections.overview: FM/AM tuner using quartz lock system.Quartz lock system with crystal oscillator is adopted.The quartz-locked system constantly compares the accurate 10.7MHz produced by the crystal oscillator with the intermediate-frequency amplified (IF) 10.7MHz. When a difference occurs, the phase comparator produces a plus / minus difference signal, and a low-pass filter controls the local oscillator. Quartz is insensitive to changes in humidity or temperature, so the oscillation frequency remains locked, eliminating post-tuning drift.In addition, a touch lock-off system is adopted, and the lock is released while the tuning knob is touched, and the quartz lock works the moment the hand is released.The front-end section uses a frequency linear precision five series varicon, and the RT-2000uses a single dual-gate MOS FET.The bandwidth of the IF section can be switched in two stages, and conditions can be set according to reception conditions.By selecting NARROW when radio wave conditions are poor, high selectivity characteristics can be obtained.The MPX section is equipped with a carrier canceler circuit that cuts the pilot signal (19kHz). The LC block filter and PLL IC, which take care of the attenuation of the sub-carrier signal (38kHz), ensure a wide range by suppressing the high-frequency degradation.Equipped with multipath detection function.For RT-2000, the indicator of the tuning meter is displayed.It is equipped with a high-blend switch that demonstrates power in weak electric field reception.The AM tuner uses a 16-pin dual in-line IC pack circuit.

sections.title: ROTEL RT-2100
sections.overview: FM stereo tuner using quartz lock system.Quartz lock system with crystal oscillator is adopted.The quartz-locked system constantly compares the accurate 10.7MHz produced by the crystal oscillator with the intermediate-frequency amplified (IF) 10.7MHz. When a difference occurs, the phase comparator produces a plus / minus difference signal, and a low-pass filter controls the local oscillator. Quartz is insensitive to changes in humidity or temperature, so the oscillation frequency remains locked, eliminating post-tuning drift.In addition, a touch lock-off system is adopted, and the lock is released while the tuning knob is touched, and the quartz lock works the moment the hand is released.Uses a tuning method with an LED indicator.When the tuning knob is touched, the induced voltage is detected and the quartz lock is released. At this time, the local frequency changes linearly. When the dial indicator comes close to the desired radio wave (  100kHz), the side indicator lights. When the indicator comes close to the desired radio wave, the green LED in the center lights. This indicates full synchronization. When the indicator comes close to the desired radio wave, the LED in the quartz lock indicator glows green, indicating that the lock has been achieved. When the knob is released, the LED in the quartz lock indicator lights green.The front end section uses a frequency linear type precision 5-row varicon.The RT the RT-2100uses three dual-gate MOS FETs for high sensitivity and excellent interference rejection.The bandwidth of the IF section can be switched in two stages, and conditions can be set according to reception conditions.By selecting NARROW when radio wave conditions are poor, high selectivity characteristics can be obtained.The MPX section is equipped with a carrier canceler circuit that cuts the pilot signal (19kHz). The LC block filter and PLL IC, which take care of the attenuation of the sub-carrier signal (38kHz), ensure a wide range by suppressing the high-frequency degradation.Equipped with tape deck and level check function.When the REC CHECK switch is turned on, a dial tone of 400Hz will be output. During an air check, the deck level will be set to reference (0dB).Equipped with multipath detection function.For RT-2100, the signal indicator shows the degree of multipath.It is equipped with a high-blend switch that demonstrates power in weak electric field reception.
